lines.text: Don't let me get on the train.
[inner voice, hushed, heart racing] Six thirty-one. Nine minutes.
[inner voice, a dry, almost bitter little laugh] ...and he had no idea.
[surprised, a polite smile] You again.
[flustered, too quick] I... take this train too. Sometimes.
[amused, gently] Sometimes.
[inner voice, hushed, embarrassed] I'd never taken this train in my life.
[standing up, easy] Well. That's mine.
[inner voice, breathless, panicking] Ten seconds. No plan.
[startled, half laughing] Hey... that's my book.
[breathless, daring, a little smile] Then come get it.
[a disbelieving laugh] ...You just made me miss my train.
[trying not to smile] I'll buy you a coffee.
[inner voice, soft, wondering] He didn't even ask why.
[inner voice, low] Forty minutes later, every phone in the café lit up at once.
[inner voice, shaken] The six-forty never made it to the next station.
lines.show: The 6:40 never made it to the next station.

lines.text: [quiet, staring at her] You knew. Didn't you?
[inner voice, hesitant, hushed] I couldn't tell him. Not yet.
[inner voice, uneasy] That night, at eleven eleven... it wasn't my phone that lit up.
lines.show: That night, at 11:11… it wasn't my phone that lit up.

lines.text: [barely a whisper, confused] Mira... why is your voice on my phone?
